content.description: Once the ActivADA mobile application installed it will ask for crypto wallet address, which will be paired with the all collected real-time data during the training (running). Carry out your workout, save the results. When the training is done, all data such as running pace, speed, distance, etc. are extracted from the API, hashed in the blockchain and streamlined to the ActivADA web-platform as the trainings statistics through the blockchain oracle. On the online platform, Validators come into play.
